plugins.name: pc-guardian
plugins.description: Windows PC health audit: performance, startup, storage, browser, security and stability. Scans only read; it changes your PC only through cleanup you approve.

plugins.name: drive-cleanup
plugins.description: Deep C: drive audit and cleanup for Windows: duplicates by SHA-256, installers, archives, developer caches, leftovers. Scans only read; Claude proposes, you answer once; files go to a restorable quarantine. Beta.

plugins.name: wifi-optimizer
plugins.description: Wi-Fi and home network diagnosis: link and channel congestion, hop-by-hop latency, DNS, throughput and bufferbloat, measured one at a time. Ranks the real bottlenecks, guides router fixes you make, then re-measures Before vs. After. Only reads. macOS; Linux and Windows untested. Beta.
